meta.title: Setup and downloads — Mise
meta.description: Install Mise on your devices. Web app, Chrome extension, Android order phone, kitchen screen and your own Vercel deployment.

hero.title: Install Mise on your devices
hero.lead: Everything downloads free from our GitHub repo. The Chrome extension and the Android app are developer builds that aren’t in any store, so you install them in developer mode. About 5 minutes per device.

availability.preview: Mise is rolling out in stages. The web app is currently a preview; device builds will appear here when they’re ready.
availability.empty: Device builds are coming in a later version.
availability.error: Couldn’t check downloads. Try again, or view the manifest below.

devices.title: Chrome extension
devices.subtitle: Shop PC · reads delivery-app tabs, fills courier forms

devices.title: Android order phone
devices.subtitle: Shop phone · reads WhatsApp, bKash, Nagad, calls

devices.title: Kitchen screen
devices.subtitle: Any tablet or phone · works offline

guides.title: Chrome extension
guides.lead: On the shop PC. Use Chrome or Edge.

steps.title: Download and unzip
steps.text: Unzip mise-extension.zip into a folder you won’t delete, such as Documents › Mise.

steps.title: Open the extensions page
steps.text: Type chrome://extensions in the address bar (Edge: edge://extensions).

steps.title: Turn on Developer mode
steps.text: The switch is at the top right of the page.

steps.title: Click “Load unpacked” and choose the folder
steps.text: Pick the folder that contains manifest.json.

steps.title: Pin Mise and pair it
steps.text: Click the puzzle icon, pin Mise, open it and enter the 6-digit code from Mise › Settings › Devices.

steps.title: If Chrome warns about developer-mode extensions
steps.text: That’s expected for builds outside the Chrome Web Store. Keep the extension on.

guides.title: Android order phone
guides.lead: On the phone that receives WhatsApp, bKash and calls.

steps.title: Open this page on the phone and tap Download .apk
steps.text: Or scan the QR in Mise › Settings › Devices.

steps.title: Allow from unknown sources
steps.text: Android blocks apps from unknown sources by default. When you open the file, tap Settings and turn on “Allow from this source” for Chrome (or Settings › Apps › Special app access › Install unknown apps). Older phones: Settings › Security › Unknown sources. Names vary by brand.

steps.title: Go back, open the file and tap Install
steps.text: If Play Protect warns, tap More details › Install anyway. It’s a developer build, not a store app.

steps.title: Allow notification access
steps.text: Choose only WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, bKash, Nagad and Phone.

steps.title: Turn off battery optimisation for Mise
steps.text: So Android doesn’t stop it during a busy shift.

steps.title: Pair the phone
steps.text: Scan the pairing QR in Mise › Settings › Devices. The phone appears as “Order phone · online”.

cable.title: Prefer a cable?
cable.text: Turn on USB debugging in Developer options, connect the phone, then run:

checksum.title: Check the download
checksum.text: Compare the fingerprint with the one listed next to the file in the repo.
checksum.command:
shasum -a 256 mise-order-phone.apk
# Windows: certutil -hashfile mise-order-phone.apk SHA256

updates.title: Updates
updates.text: Mise tells you in the app when a newer build is in the repo.
items: Extension: replace the folder, then click the reload icon on chrome://extensions
Android: install the new APK over the old one. Your data stays.

browserGuides.title: Web app
browserGuides.text: The current app is a coming-soon screen. When the offline app ships, you can install it without an app store.
steps: On Android or desktop Chrome, use the browser’s Install app option. On iPhone, use Safari › Share › Add to Home Screen.
Keep it in a browser if you prefer. The same app works there.

browserGuides.title: Kitchen screen
browserGuides.text: The kitchen screen arrives in Phase 3. A browser is enough; install the web app to keep it within one tap.
steps: Open Mise on the kitchen tablet or spare phone.
When available, choose Settings › Devices › Kitchen screen and pair it with your outlet.
Keep the screen awake, turn the volume up and place a test order. The cook taps Got it, then Ready.

selfHost.title: Run your own copy on Vercel
selfHost.lead: Prefer your own address and your own account? Let your AI agent deploy the web app to Vercel in a few minutes. Your data, your domain, our updates.
selfHost.agentTitle: Let your AI agent do it
selfHost.agentLead: Works with Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands on your computer.

steps.title: Fork the Mise repo on GitHub
steps.text: One click: Fork. You now have your own copy to deploy and update.

steps.title: Paste this prompt into your agent
steps.text: It clones your fork, installs the Vercel CLI and runs the build.

steps.title: Approve the Vercel sign-in
steps.text: The agent opens a browser window. You sign in; it never sees your password.

steps.title: Get your link
steps.text: Something like mise-yourshop.vercel.app. Add your own domain in Vercel if you like.

selfHost.prompt:
Deploy my own copy of Mise (github.com/<you>/mise) to my Vercel account.
Follow handover/prompts/04-deploy-own-vercel.md exactly: clone, pnpm install, build with BASE_PATH=/, install the Vercel CLI, log in (I will approve in the browser), link a new project, set the env vars it lists, deploy to production, then give me the URL and explain how updates work. Ask before creating anything paid.

This is Phase 0: the app is currently a preview. No database or backend is needed now. Use the current implementation guide: {repo}/blob/main/docs/deploy-own-vercel.md
selfHost.manualLead: Click the button, sign in to Vercel and GitHub, and accept the defaults.

benefits.title: Your own address
benefits.text: yourshop.vercel.app, or connect your domain in Vercel

benefits.title: Updates
benefits.text: Sync your fork with ours; Vercel redeploys on every push

benefits.title: When you need sync (v1)
benefits.text: Accounts and multi-device need your own Supabase project. The agent sets the keys in Vercel.

benefits.title: Device apps stay the same
benefits.text: The extension and Android app point at your address after pairing.

items.title: “App not installed”
items.text: An older copy signed differently is on the phone. Uninstall it, then install again.

items.title: “Manifest file is missing”
items.text: You chose the zip or the wrong folder. Unzip first, then pick the folder with manifest.json.

items.title: No orders arriving from the phone
items.text: Re-allow notification access and turn battery optimisation off. Check Settings › Devices.

items.title: Extension stopped after a Chrome update
items.text: On chrome://extensions, make sure Developer mode is still on, and click reload.

phone.title: Set up the order phone
phone.lead: A developer build from our GitHub repo. About 3 minutes.

steps.title: Allow from unknown sources
steps.text: When Android blocks the install, tap Settings and turn on “Allow from this source”. Older phones: Settings › Security › Unknown sources.

steps.title: Tap Install
steps.text: Play Protect may warn: More details › Install anyway.

steps.title: Allow notification access
steps.text: WhatsApp, bKash, Nagad and Phone only.

steps.title: Turn off battery optimisation
steps.text: Keeps it running all shift.

steps.title: Scan the pairing QR
steps.text: From Mise › Settings › Devices on any screen.
